summary.en: Guide for an eligible Kenyan applying for a first national ID.
summary.sw: Mwongozo kwa Mkenya anayestahili kuomba kitambulisho cha kwanza.

en: Birth certificate and any supporting records requested by the registration officer
Parent/guardian identity details where applicable
Any additional documents specified by the registration office
sw: Cheti cha kuzaliwa na nyaraka za ziada atakazoomba afisa wa usajili
Taarifa za kitambulisho cha mzazi/mlezi inapohitajika
Nyaraka nyingine zitakazoelekezwa na ofisi ya usajili

en: Confirm current eligibility and required documents with the National Registration Bureau.
Visit the designated registration office or Huduma Centre if the service is offered there.
Complete registration and biometric capture as instructed.
Keep the acknowledgement/reference details for follow-up.
sw: Thibitisha ustahiki na nyaraka zinazohitajika kwa National Registration Bureau.
Tembelea ofisi ya usajili iliyoteuliwa au Huduma Centre ikiwa huduma inapatikana hapo.
Kamilisha usajili na uchukuliwe taarifa za kibayometriki kama utakavyoelekezwa.
Hifadhi nambari ya kumbukumbu au uthibitisho kwa ajili ya ufuatiliaji.

note.en: Exact requirements can vary by applicant and registration location. Confirm the current checklist before travelling.
note.sw: Mahitaji yanaweza kutofautiana kulingana na mwombaji na eneo la usajili. Thibitisha orodha ya sasa kabla ya kusafiri.

summary.en: What to check when an ID is lost, damaged, or needs replacement.
summary.sw: Mambo ya kuangalia kitambulisho kinapopotea, kuharibika au kuhitaji kubadilishwa.

en: Any available copy or details of the previous ID
Police abstract or other loss documentation if required for the case
Other identity/supporting documents requested by the registration office
sw: Nakala au taarifa zozote za kitambulisho cha awali ikiwa zinapatikana
Police abstract au nyaraka za kupotea ikiwa zinahitajika kwa hali husika
Nyaraka nyingine za utambulisho zitakazoombwa na ofisi ya usajili

en: Check the current replacement process with the National Registration Bureau or Huduma Kenya.
Ask which evidence is required for your specific case (lost, damaged, or correction).
Submit the request at the designated office and follow the issued instructions.
Keep the acknowledgement for collection or tracking.
sw: Angalia mchakato wa sasa wa kubadilisha kitambulisho kupitia National Registration Bureau au Huduma Kenya.
Uliza ushahidi unaohitajika kwa hali yako (kupotea, kuharibika au kusahihisha taarifa).
Wasilisha ombi katika ofisi iliyoteuliwa na ufuate maelekezo.
Hifadhi uthibitisho wa kufuatilia au kuchukua kitambulisho.

note.en: Requirements for replacement and data corrections may differ; confirm before paying or travelling.
note.sw: Mahitaji ya kubadilisha na kusahihisha taarifa yanaweza kutofautiana; thibitisha kabla ya kulipa au kusafiri.

summary.en: Official guidance for a first-time passport application.
summary.sw: Mwongozo rasmi wa kuomba pasipoti kwa mara ya kwanza.

en: Duly completed Form 19 and two payment invoices
Original birth certificate and copy for citizens by birth
Original national ID and copy for adults
Parents’ birth certificates and ID copies where required
Consent form and parents’ ID copies for minors, where applicable
Prescribed fee payment evidence
sw: Fomu 19 iliyojazwa na ankara mbili za malipo
Cheti halisi cha kuzaliwa na nakala kwa raia kwa kuzaliwa
Kitambulisho halisi cha taifa na nakala kwa watu wazima
Vyeti vya kuzaliwa vya wazazi na nakala za vitambulisho pale vinapohitajika
Fomu ya idhini na nakala za vitambulisho vya wazazi kwa watoto inapohitajika
Uthibitisho wa malipo ya ada iliyowekwa

en: Read the official requirements page and select the correct passport category.
Apply and pay through the official eCitizen immigration portal.
Book an appointment through the official process.
Attend the selected passport processing centre for document submission and biometrics.
Track progress using the official portal/SMS/email instructions.
sw: Soma ukurasa rasmi wa mahitaji na uchague aina sahihi ya pasipoti.
Tuma ombi na ulipe kupitia tovuti rasmi ya uhamiaji ya eCitizen.
Panga miadi kupitia mchakato rasmi.
Hudhuria kituo ulichochagua kwa kuwasilisha nyaraka na kuchukuliwa taarifa za kibayometriki.
Fuatilia maendeleo kupitia maelekezo rasmi ya tovuti/SMS/barua pepe.

services.sourceLabel: Directorate of Immigration Services — Application Requirements

note.en: The official requirements page may be updated. Check it again before applying.
note.sw: Ukurasa rasmi wa mahitaji unaweza kusasishwa. Ukague tena kabla ya kutuma ombi.

summary.en: Requirements vary for replacement, damage, loss, and name changes.
summary.sw: Mahitaji hutofautiana kwa kubadilisha, kuharibika, kupotea na kubadilisha majina.

en: Completed Form 19 and two payment invoices
Original national ID and copy for adults
Previous passport and copy for replacement, if available
For a lost passport: personal statement, sworn affidavit, police abstract, and bio-data page copy if available
For a damaged passport: personal statement and supporting sworn affidavit
For a name change: supporting documents such as deed poll, Gazette notice, or marriage certificate, as applicable
sw: Fomu 19 iliyojazwa na ankara mbili za malipo
Kitambulisho halisi cha taifa na nakala kwa watu wazima
Pasipoti ya awali na nakala ikiwa inapatikana
Kwa pasipoti iliyopotea: maelezo binafsi, affidavit, police abstract na nakala ya ukurasa wa taarifa ikiwa inapatikana
Kwa pasipoti iliyoharibika: maelezo binafsi na affidavit ya kuthibitisha
Kwa kubadilisha jina: nyaraka kama deed poll, tangazo la Gazette au cheti cha ndoa inapohitajika

en: Choose the correct replacement reason on the official immigration guidance.
Check the current category-specific document list.
Apply and pay only through the official eCitizen portal.
Attend the appointment/biometrics process specified by Immigration.
Keep all receipts and reference details.
sw: Chagua sababu sahihi ya kubadilisha kwenye mwongozo rasmi wa uhamiaji.
Angalia orodha ya nyaraka ya aina yako ya ombi.
Tuma ombi na ulipe kupitia eCitizen rasmi pekee.
Hudhuria miadi na mchakato wa biometriki utakaoelekezwa na Uhamiaji.
Hifadhi risiti na nambari za kumbukumbu.

services.sourceLabel: Directorate of Immigration Services — Application Requirements

note.en: This guide summarizes categories; use the official page for the final checklist for your exact case.
note.sw: Mwongozo huu unafupisha aina za maombi; tumia ukurasa rasmi kwa orodha ya mwisho ya hali yako.

summary.en: Police clearance certificate application guide.
summary.sw: Mwongozo wa kuomba cheti cha polisi.

en: Valid national ID or other identity document accepted for your applicant category
Application details and payment confirmation generated by the official portal
Any additional documents specified by DCI for your category
sw: Kitambulisho halali cha taifa au nyaraka nyingine inayokubaliwa kwa aina yako ya mwombaji
Taarifa za ombi na uthibitisho wa malipo kutoka tovuti rasmi
Nyaraka nyingine zitakazotajwa na DCI kwa aina yako ya mwombaji

en: Open the official DCI/eCitizen service and read the current instructions.
Complete the application and pay only through the official channel.
Follow the official instructions for fingerprint capture and identity verification.
Use the official portal to check status or collection instructions.
sw: Fungua huduma rasmi ya DCI/eCitizen na usome maelekezo ya sasa.
Jaza ombi na ulipe kupitia njia rasmi pekee.
Fuata maelekezo rasmi ya kuchukuliwa alama za vidole na uhakiki wa utambulisho.
Tumia tovuti rasmi kuangalia hali au maelekezo ya kuchukua cheti.

note.en: Applicant-category requirements and fingerprint arrangements should be confirmed in the current DCI portal.
note.sw: Mahitaji kulingana na aina ya mwombaji na mpangilio wa alama za vidole uthibitishwe kwenye tovuti ya sasa ya DCI.

summary.en: Apply for a birth certificate or check registration steps.
summary.sw: Omba cheti cha kuzaliwa au angalia hatua za usajili.

en: Birth notification or facility notification details, where applicable
Parents’ identity details/documents as requested
Application form and invoice generated by Civil Registration Services
Additional supporting records for late registration or special cases
sw: Taarifa ya kuzaliwa au taarifa kutoka kituo cha afya inapohitajika
Taarifa/nyaraka za utambulisho wa wazazi kama zitakavyoombwa
Fomu ya ombi na ankara kutoka Civil Registration Services
Nyaraka za ziada kwa usajili wa kuchelewa au hali maalumu

en: Select the correct service: current birth, late birth, or correction of particulars.
Apply through the official Civil Registration Services/eCitizen portal.
Follow instructions to print the application/invoice and submit documents if requested.
Check status and collection instructions through the official channel.
sw: Chagua huduma sahihi: kuzaliwa kwa sasa, usajili wa kuchelewa au kusahihisha taarifa.
Tuma ombi kupitia tovuti rasmi ya Civil Registration Services/eCitizen.
Fuata maelekezo ya kuchapisha ombi/ankara na kuwasilisha nyaraka ukitakiwa.
Angalia hali na maelekezo ya kuchukua kupitia njia rasmi.

note.en: The portal distinguishes birth registration types; use the exact category that matches the case.
note.sw: Tovuti hutofautisha aina za usajili wa kuzaliwa; chagua aina inayolingana na hali yako.

summary.en: For births reported more than six months after the date of birth.
summary.sw: Kwa kuzaliwa kulikoripotiwa zaidi ya miezi sita baada ya tarehe ya kuzaliwa.

en: Supporting evidence of birth and date, as required by Civil Registration Services
Parents’ identity details and records where applicable
Any additional evidence requested for late registration
sw: Ushahidi wa kuzaliwa na tarehe yake kama utakavyoombwa na Civil Registration Services
Taarifa na nyaraka za utambulisho wa wazazi inapohitajika
Ushahidi mwingine utakaoombwa kwa usajili wa kuchelewa

en: Choose the late birth registration service on the official CRS portal.
Read the case-specific checklist before starting.
Submit the application and provide supporting records as directed.
Follow the official instructions for review and certificate collection.
sw: Chagua huduma ya usajili wa kuzaliwa kwa kuchelewa kwenye tovuti rasmi ya CRS.
Soma orodha ya nyaraka ya hali yako kabla ya kuanza.
Wasilisha ombi na nyaraka za ushahidi kama utakavyoelekezwa.
Fuata maelekezo rasmi ya uhakiki na kuchukua cheti.

note.en: Late-registration evidence depends on the case. Confirm the complete list with CRS.
note.sw: Ushahidi wa usajili wa kuchelewa hutegemea hali. Thibitisha orodha kamili kwa CRS.

summary.en: Guide for current or replacement death certificate services.
summary.sw: Mwongozo wa cheti kipya au mbadala cha kifo.

en: Death notification or registration reference, where available
Applicant’s identification and relationship details if requested
Supporting records specified by Civil Registration Services
sw: Taarifa ya kifo au kumbukumbu ya usajili ikiwa inapatikana
Kitambulisho cha mwombaji na maelezo ya uhusiano ikiwa yataombwa
Nyaraka za ushahidi zitakazotajwa na Civil Registration Services

en: Select the correct death certificate service for the county/event and request type.
Apply using the official CRS/eCitizen portal.
Provide the documents requested for the specific case.
Follow official instructions for processing and collection.
sw: Chagua huduma sahihi ya cheti cha kifo kulingana na kaunti/tukio na aina ya ombi.
Tuma ombi kupitia CRS/eCitizen rasmi.
Wasilisha nyaraka zinazoombwa kwa hali husika.
Fuata maelekezo rasmi ya uchakataji na kuchukua cheti.

note.en: CRS has different flows depending on where the death occurred. Confirm the correct route first.
note.sw: CRS ina michakato tofauti kulingana na mahali kifo kilitokea. Thibitisha njia sahihi kwanza.

summary.en: Start the official process for learner-driver services.
summary.sw: Anza mchakato rasmi wa huduma za dereva mwanafunzi.

en: eCitizen account and identity details required by NTSA
Application details requested in the official portal
Payment confirmation, if a fee is displayed
sw: Akaunti ya eCitizen na taarifa za utambulisho zinazohitajika na NTSA
Taarifa za ombi zitakazoombwa kwenye tovuti rasmi
Uthibitisho wa malipo ikiwa ada itaonyeshwa

en: Sign in to the official NTSA/eCitizen service.
Choose Provisional Driving Licence and follow the current prompts.
Pay only through the official payment flow, if required.
Download or print the issued document and follow learner-driver rules.
sw: Ingia kwenye huduma rasmi ya NTSA/eCitizen.
Chagua Provisional Driving Licence na ufuate maelekezo ya sasa.
Lipa kupitia mfumo rasmi pekee ikiwa inahitajika.
Pakua au chapisha nyaraka iliyotolewa na ufuate sheria za dereva mwanafunzi.

note.en: The NTSA portal controls the current application fields and eligibility rules.
note.sw: Tovuti ya NTSA ndiyo huonyesha sehemu za ombi na masharti ya sasa.

title.sw: Kuweka nafasi ya mtihani wa udereva

summary.en: How to find the official driving test booking service.
summary.sw: Jinsi ya kupata huduma rasmi ya kuweka nafasi ya mtihani.

en: NTSA/eCitizen account and identity details
Relevant learner/provisional licence details if requested
Driving school or training details if requested by the portal
sw: Akaunti ya NTSA/eCitizen na taarifa za utambulisho
Taarifa za leseni ya mwanafunzi ikiwa zitaombwa
Taarifa za shule ya udereva au mafunzo ikiwa zitaombwa na tovuti

en: Open the official NTSA service portal.
Select Driving Test Application and follow eligibility instructions.
Choose an available test option/date as displayed.
Keep the confirmation and follow instructions for the test centre.
sw: Fungua tovuti rasmi ya huduma za NTSA.
Chagua Driving Test Application na ufuate masharti ya ustahiki.
Chagua chaguo/tarehe ya mtihani inayoonyeshwa.
Hifadhi uthibitisho na ufuate maelekezo ya kituo cha mtihani.

note.en: Confirm available test centres, dates, and prerequisites in the portal.
note.sw: Thibitisha vituo, tarehe na masharti ya awali kwenye tovuti.

summary.en: Renewal route and preparation checklist.
summary.sw: Njia ya kufanya upya leseni na orodha ya maandalizi.

en: Existing driving licence details
National ID/eCitizen account details
Any additional information requested by NTSA
sw: Taarifa za leseni ya udereva iliyopo
Taarifa za kitambulisho/akaunti ya eCitizen
Taarifa nyingine zitakazoombwa na NTSA

en: Sign in to the official NTSA/eCitizen portal.
Choose Driving Licence Renewal and review the current term/options.
Pay using the official portal if required.
Save the renewal slip or confirmation and follow the portal's instructions.
sw: Ingia kwenye tovuti rasmi ya NTSA/eCitizen.
Chagua Driving Licence Renewal na kagua muda/chaguo zinazopatikana.
Lipa kupitia tovuti rasmi ikiwa inahitajika.
Hifadhi hati au uthibitisho wa kufanya upya na ufuate maelekezo ya tovuti.

note.en: Licence products and renewal periods can change; confirm the option shown for your licence.
note.sw: Aina za leseni na muda wa kufanya upya unaweza kubadilika; thibitisha chaguo linaloonyeshwa kwa leseni yako.

summary.en: Find the official route for KRA PIN registration and tax services.
summary.sw: Pata njia rasmi ya kusajili PIN ya KRA na huduma za kodi.

en: National ID details for an individual Kenyan applicant
Valid email and phone details as requested by KRA
Additional supporting details depending on applicant type
sw: Taarifa za kitambulisho cha taifa kwa mwombaji Mkenya binafsi
Barua pepe na simu halali kama KRA itakavyoomba
Taarifa za ziada kulingana na aina ya mwombaji

en: Open the official KRA website/iTax service.
Select the correct taxpayer category and registration service.
Complete the requested information carefully.
Save the PIN certificate and keep your login details private.
sw: Fungua tovuti rasmi ya KRA/iTax.
Chagua aina sahihi ya mlipa kodi na huduma ya usajili.
Jaza taarifa zinazohitajika kwa makini.
Hifadhi cheti cha PIN na linda taarifa zako za kuingia.

note.en: Requirements differ for individuals, companies, and non-citizens. Use the correct category.
note.sw: Mahitaji hutofautiana kwa watu binafsi, kampuni na wasio raia. Tumia aina sahihi.

title.sw: Kuwasilisha marejesho ya kodi ya mtu binafsi

summary.en: Preparation guide for individual tax return filing.
summary.sw: Mwongozo wa kuandaa na kuwasilisha marejesho ya kodi ya mtu binafsi.

en: KRA PIN and iTax access
Income records for the relevant tax year
Employment documents such as P9, if employed
Allowable deduction/supporting records relevant to your situation
sw: PIN ya KRA na uwezo wa kuingia iTax
Rekodi za mapato za mwaka husika wa kodi
Nyaraka za ajira kama P9 ikiwa umeajiriwa
Rekodi za makato yanayokubalika zinazohusu hali yako

en: Check KRA's current filing guidance and deadline.
Sign in to iTax and select the correct return type and tax year.
Enter information using your supporting records.
Submit and save the acknowledgement/receipt; seek KRA guidance if unsure.
sw: Angalia mwongozo na tarehe ya mwisho ya KRA ya sasa.
Ingia iTax na uchague aina sahihi ya marejesho na mwaka wa kodi.
Weka taarifa kwa kutumia rekodi zako.
Wasilisha na uhifadhi uthibitisho; omba mwongozo wa KRA ikiwa huna uhakika.

note.en: Tax rules and deadlines can change. This guide is not tax advice.
note.sw: Sheria na tarehe za kodi zinaweza kubadilika. Mwongozo huu si ushauri wa kodi.

summary.en: Where to start with business-name registration.
summary.sw: Mahali pa kuanzia kusajili jina la biashara.

en: Applicant identity and contact details
Proposed business name(s) and business activity details
Additional details requested by the Business Registration Service portal
sw: Taarifa za utambulisho na mawasiliano ya mwombaji
Jina/jina mbadala la biashara na maelezo ya shughuli
Taarifa za ziada zitakazoombwa na tovuti ya Business Registration Service

en: Open the official Business Registration Service portal via eCitizen.
Choose the relevant business registration service.
Enter the requested details and follow the name reservation/application steps.
Pay only through the official portal and save the generated documents.
sw: Fungua tovuti rasmi ya Business Registration Service kupitia eCitizen.
Chagua huduma husika ya usajili wa biashara.
Weka taarifa zinazohitajika na ufuate hatua za kuhifadhi jina/kuomba usajili.
Lipa kupitia tovuti rasmi pekee na uhifadhi nyaraka zinazotolewa.

note.en: A business name is not the same as incorporating a limited company. Select the correct legal form.
note.sw: Jina la biashara si sawa na kusajili kampuni yenye dhima ndogo. Chagua aina sahihi ya kisheria.

title.sw: Usajili wa ndoa / cheti cha ndoa

summary.en: Find the official route for marriage registration and certificates.
summary.sw: Pata njia rasmi ya kusajili ndoa na kupata cheti.

en: Identity documents for the parties
Documents proving the applicable marriage process/type
Witness details and notices/forms as required by the Registrar of Marriages
Additional documents specified for civil, Christian, customary, or other applicable process
sw: Nyaraka za utambulisho wa wahusika
Nyaraka zinazoonyesha aina ya mchakato wa ndoa husika
Taarifa za mashahidi na matangazo/fomu kama Msajili wa Ndoa atakavyoomba
Nyaraka za ziada kulingana na ndoa ya kiraia, Kikristo, kimila au mchakato mwingine husika

en: Identify the applicable marriage type and read the official Registrar of Marriages guidance.
Use the official government portal or contact the Registrar for the current checklist.
Submit notices/forms and supporting documents as instructed.
Follow official appointment, ceremony, registration, and certificate steps.
sw: Tambua aina ya ndoa na usome mwongozo rasmi wa Msajili wa Ndoa.
Tumia tovuti rasmi ya serikali au wasiliana na Msajili kupata orodha ya sasa.
Wasilisha matangazo/fomu na nyaraka za ushahidi kama utakavyoelekezwa.
Fuata hatua rasmi za miadi, sherehe, usajili na cheti.

services.agency: Office of the Attorney General / Registrar of Marriages

note.en: Marriage requirements differ by type and circumstances; confirm the exact process with the Registrar.
note.sw: Mahitaji ya ndoa hutofautiana kwa aina na hali; thibitisha mchakato husika kwa Msajili.

summary.en: Start an official land search and understand what to prepare.
summary.sw: Anza utafutaji rasmi wa ardhi na ujue cha kuandaa.

en: Land title/parcel number and location details
Applicant eCitizen account and identity details
Any supporting authority/consent requested by the official service
sw: Nambari ya hati/kipande cha ardhi na maelezo ya eneo
Akaunti ya eCitizen na taarifa za utambulisho wa mwombaji
Idhini/nyaraka za ziada zitakazoombwa na huduma rasmi

en: Open the official Ministry of Lands / eCitizen service.
Choose the land search service and enter the parcel/title details carefully.
Pay through the official payment flow if required.
Save the official search result and verify any legal decision with a qualified professional.
sw: Fungua huduma rasmi ya Wizara ya Ardhi/eCitizen.
Chagua huduma ya utafutaji na uweke maelezo ya kipande/hati kwa makini.
Lipa kupitia mfumo rasmi ikiwa inahitajika.
Hifadhi matokeo rasmi na thibitisha maamuzi ya kisheria na mtaalamu anayestahili.

services.sourceLabel: Government of Kenya / Ministry of Lands

note.en: Land services vary by parcel, registry, and transaction. Do not rely on this guide as a legal title opinion.
note.sw: Huduma za ardhi hutegemea kipande, sajili na muamala. Usichukulie mwongozo huu kama maoni ya kisheria kuhusu umiliki.

summary.en: Official travel authorisation information for eligible visitors to Kenya.
summary.sw: Taarifa rasmi za idhini ya kusafiri kwa wageni wanaostahiki kuingia Kenya.

en: Valid passport details
Travel itinerary and accommodation/contact details requested by the portal
Payment method and any supporting information required for the traveller's category
sw: Taarifa za pasipoti halali
Ratiba ya safari na maelezo ya malazi/mawasiliano yatakayoombwa
Njia ya malipo na taarifa za ziada zinazohitajika kwa aina ya msafiri

en: Check whether an eTA is required for your nationality and travel situation.
Apply only through the official Kenya eTA portal.
Upload the requested information and pay through the official flow.
Wait for the official decision before travelling; check validity and entry conditions.
sw: Angalia kama eTA inahitajika kwa uraia na hali yako ya safari.
Tuma ombi kupitia tovuti rasmi ya eTA ya Kenya pekee.
Pakia taarifa zinazoombwa na ulipe kupitia mfumo rasmi.
Subiri uamuzi rasmi kabla ya kusafiri; kagua uhalali na masharti ya kuingia.

services.sourceLabel: Directorate of Immigration Services / official eTA portal

note.en: Entry rules and exemptions can change; check the official portal before booking or travelling.
note.sw: Sheria za kuingia na misamaha zinaweza kubadilika; kagua tovuti rasmi kabla ya kuweka nafasi au kusafiri.

summary.en: For foreign students admitted to an education or training institution in Kenya.
summary.sw: Kwa wanafunzi wa kigeni waliokubaliwa katika taasisi ya elimu au mafunzo nchini Kenya.

en: Admission letter from the education/training institution
Passport and applicant details
Institution/supporting documents and forms specified by Immigration
Any additional documents shown on the official portal
sw: Barua ya udahili kutoka taasisi ya elimu/mafunzo
Pasipoti na taarifa za mwombaji
Nyaraka na fomu za taasisi/ushahidi zitakazotajwa na Uhamiaji
Nyaraka nyingine zitakazoonyeshwa kwenye tovuti rasmi

en: Check the official Immigration student pass requirements.
Prepare the admission letter and the documents listed for your case.
Apply through the official eCitizen Immigration portal.
Follow the official instructions for review, biometrics, and issuance.
sw: Angalia mahitaji rasmi ya student pass ya Uhamiaji.
Andaa barua ya udahili na nyaraka zilizoorodheshwa kwa hali yako.
Tuma ombi kupitia tovuti rasmi ya eCitizen Immigration.
Fuata maelekezo rasmi ya uhakiki, biometriki na kutolewa kwa pass.

services.sourceLabel: Directorate of Immigration Services official portal

note.en: This service is for foreign students; Kenyan citizens should not use this guide for a student pass.
note.sw: Huduma hii ni ya wanafunzi wa kigeni; raia wa Kenya hawapaswi kutumia mwongozo huu kwa student pass.

summary.en: How to find the official process for recording/reporting an incident and obtaining an abstract.
summary.sw: Jinsi ya kupata mchakato rasmi wa kuripoti tukio na kupata abstract.

en: Identity details
Incident details including date, location, and description
Any evidence or reference number available
Additional information requested by the police station or official service
sw: Taarifa za utambulisho
Maelezo ya tukio, tarehe, eneo na kilichotokea
Ushahidi au nambari ya kumbukumbu ikiwa inapatikana
Taarifa nyingine zitakazoombwa na kituo cha polisi au huduma rasmi

en: Report the incident through the appropriate official police channel or station.
Provide accurate incident details and supporting information.
Ask the officer for the reference/abstract process applicable to the incident.
Keep the issued reference and confirm whether a fee or further step applies through official channels.
sw: Ripoti tukio kupitia njia rasmi ya polisi au kituo kinachofaa.
Toa maelezo sahihi ya tukio na taarifa za ushahidi.
Muulize afisa kuhusu mchakato wa kumbukumbu/abstract unaohusika.
Hifadhi kumbukumbu iliyotolewa na uthibitishe kama kuna ada au hatua nyingine kupitia njia rasmi.

note.en: Procedure can depend on the incident and station. This app does not replace reporting directly to police.
note.sw: Mchakato unaweza kutegemea tukio na kituo. Programu hii haichukui nafasi ya kuripoti moja kwa moja kwa polisi.

summary.en: Find a centre and confirm which services are offered there.
summary.sw: Tafuta kituo na uthibitishe huduma zinazotolewa hapo.

en: Know the service you need and your county/town
Carry the service-specific documents listed in the relevant guide
Appointment/reference details if the agency requires them
sw: Jua huduma unayohitaji na kaunti/mji wako
Beba nyaraka maalumu zilizoorodheshwa kwenye mwongozo wa huduma
Maelezo ya miadi/kumbukumbu ikiwa idara inayahitaji

en: Open the official Huduma Kenya website and choose Find a Centre / Find a Service.
Contact or check the selected centre to confirm the service is available there.
Check opening hours and appointment rules before travelling.
Carry originals and copies only as required by the service.
sw: Fungua tovuti rasmi ya Huduma Kenya na uchague Tafuta Kituo/Huduma.
Wasiliana na kituo ulichochagua kuthibitisha huduma inapatikana hapo.
Angalia saa za kazi na masharti ya miadi kabla ya kusafiri.
Beba nyaraka halisi na nakala pale tu zinapohitajika.

note.en: Not every service is available at every centre. Confirm first; Huduma Kenya lists the help line 1919.
note.sw: Si kila huduma inapatikana katika kila kituo. Thibitisha kwanza; Huduma Kenya inaorodhesha nambari ya msaada 1919.

summary.en: Get started with the official digital identity and government-service account.
summary.sw: Anza kutumia utambulisho wa kidijitali na akaunti rasmi ya huduma za serikali.

en: National ID or the identity information required for your user category
Active phone number and other verification details requested by eCitizen
Secure access to your own email/phone
sw: Kitambulisho cha taifa au taarifa za utambulisho zinazohitajika kwa aina yako ya mtumiaji
Nambari ya simu inayotumika na taarifa nyingine za uthibitishaji zitakazoombwa na eCitizen
Uwezo salama wa kufikia barua pepe/simu yako

en: Use the official eCitizen website or official mobile app listing.
Register or sign in using your own details.
Complete identity verification steps shown by the platform.
Never share your password, PIN, OTP, or wallet credentials with another person.
sw: Tumia tovuti rasmi ya eCitizen au ukurasa rasmi wa programu ya simu.
Jisajili au ingia kwa taarifa zako mwenyewe.
Kamilisha hatua za uthibitishaji zinazoonyeshwa na mfumo.
Usimpe mtu mwingine nenosiri, PIN, OTP au taarifa za wallet.

services.sourceLabel: eCitizen and ICT Authority official information

note.en: Use only official domains and app listings. Huduma Guide does not collect government login credentials.
note.sw: Tumia vikoa na kurasa rasmi pekee. Huduma Guide haikusanyi taarifa za kuingia kwenye akaunti za serikali.

summary.en: For official authentication/legalisation services where applicable.
summary.sw: Kwa huduma rasmi za uthibitishaji/uhalalishaji pale zinapohitajika.

en: Original certificate and supporting academic records as requested
Applicant identity details
Application form/invoice and any supporting evidence required by the responsible ministry
sw: Cheti halisi na rekodi za masomo zitakazoombwa
Taarifa za utambulisho wa mwombaji
Fomu/ankara ya ombi na ushahidi mwingine unaohitajika na wizara husika

en: Confirm which authority must authenticate the certificate for your intended use.
Use the relevant official government portal and read its category-specific requirements.
Submit the required documents and pay only through official channels.
Keep the authentication result and verify any receiving institution's separate rules.
sw: Thibitisha mamlaka inayopaswa kuthibitisha cheti kwa matumizi unayokusudia.
Tumia tovuti rasmi husika na usome mahitaji ya aina yako.
Wasilisha nyaraka na ulipe kupitia njia rasmi pekee.
Hifadhi matokeo ya uthibitishaji na angalia masharti tofauti ya taasisi itakayopokea cheti.

services.agency: Ministry of Foreign and Diaspora Affairs / relevant authority
services.sourceLabel: Ministry of Foreign and Diaspora Affairs eCitizen services

note.en: Authentication is not the same as replacing a lost certificate or academic equivalency. Confirm the correct service.
note.sw: Uthibitishaji si sawa na kubadilisha cheti kilichopotea au kutathmini usawa wa elimu. Thibitisha huduma sahihi.

sourcePolicy: Only publish final document requirements as verified when confirmed from a current official agency page. Some checklists are intentionally marked verify because requirements depend on case and portal instructions.
